question: Which athlete broke the Australian national 200 m record with a time of 20.02 seconds at the Golden Spike meet in Ostrava in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gout Gout**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gout Gout**, a rising star in **Australian athletics**, shattered the long-standing national record in the **200m** sprint.
 
• The feat was achieved at the **Golden Spike meet** held in **Ostrava**, **Czech Republic**, during the **2025** season.
 
• He recorded an extraordinary time of **20.02 seconds**, which officially surpassed the previous **Australian** national mark. ***Hence, the statement regarding his record-breaking run is correct.***
 
• This performance is significant as it broke the record previously held by the legendary **Peter Norman**, whose time of **20.06 seconds** had stood since the **1968 Mexico City Olympics**.
